sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))))
    return out
def diff(a,b):
    ch=[]
    for c in sorted(set(a)|set(b)):
        if a.get(c)!=b.get(c): ch.append(c)
    return ch
probes=[('redStair',19,46),('blueStair',36,47),('emptyCharcoal',45,20),('boxFloor',41,10),('yellow',20,24),('redBar',31,14)]
for name,r,c in probes:
    before=snap(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after=snap(current_frame)
    ch=diff(before,after)
    print(name, 'CHG' if ch else 'nochange', ch)
    if ch:
        for c2 in ch:
            print('   ',c2,'before:',before.get(c2))
            print('   ',c2,'after :',after.get(c2))
print('RES', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','score','done','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
